name: clawsembly-kernel
description: Run an exact, unmodified OpenClaw release entirely inside a browser on an OSS, self-hostable kernel.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.relay:check: npm run relay:patch && cargo fmt --manifest-path relay/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo check --locked --manifest-path relay/Cargo.toml && cargo test --locked --manifest-path relay/Cargo.toml
scripts.broker:check: cargo fmt --manifest-path provider-broker/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo check --locked --manifest-path provider-broker/Cargo.toml && cargo test --locked --manifest-path provider-broker/Cargo.toml
scripts.check: npm run contract:check && npm run build && npm run relay:check && npm run broker:check && npm run test:clawsemblyfs && npm run test:agent-turn-response && npm run test:browser && npm run test:edgejs
